narrative.overview: The TileLang-Ascend Multi-Agent Operator Optimization Workbench treats multi-branch kernel exploration not as a transient chat stream or a glowing cyberpunk telemetry wall, but as a precision geological survey and hardware engineering ledger. Each search depth forms a horizontal stratum (STRATUM D0 through STRATUM D3); each optimization node is a core sample bearing an 8-stage execution strip, Ascend 910B2 hardware pipeline utilization bars, and immutable @vN file provenance.
keyCharacteristics: Daylight-first warm archival limestone surface (#f4f1ea) paired with deep obsidian ink (#191714) and high-contrast mineral semantic pigments.

Dual-axis truth separation: execution status (completed, running, failed, stopped, skipped, pending) and content cooling state (hot, ready-for-cool, cooled) never share a badge shape or conflate color + icon encoding.
Tabular monospace precision (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) across every latency readout (132.4 us), speedup ratio (1.88x), SHA256 digest, and stage attempt code (G1@v1<-P1, G2@v2<-C1,C2).

Dual-view synchronized navigation: switching between the Stratigraphic Search Tree and the Agent Trajectory Swimlane preserves the active node, stage, attempt, and URL query locator (?view=...&node=...&stage=...&attempt=...&edge=...).

rules.name: The Dual-State Orthogonal Rule
rules.body: Never merge executionStatus and contentStatus into a single badge or color channel; every node and resource card must render execution status with its geometric status icon alongside a separate content cooling badge (hot / ready-for-cool / cooled).

rules.name: The Verified-Only Best Kernel Rule
rules.body: Never style an unverified or in-flight node (N5) with the Malachite 'Best Valid' badge; only nodes that have passed Stage 5 (verify) may enter the best valid kernel ranking.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Every numeric metric, latency delta, core utilization percentage, and version identifier must use the monospace stack with tabular-nums enabled so vertical comparison columns align to the pixel.

rules.name: The Above-the-Fold Provenance Rule
rules.body: On standard desktop viewports (1440x960), the Right Inspector must use the 2-column .file-repo-split layout so the selected node's 8-stage attempt chain and live @vN source preview are simultaneously visible without scrolling.

rules.name: The No-Neon-Glow Rule
rules.body: Never use blurred neon drop shadows, dark-on-dark glassmorphism, or gradients to indicate active selection; use a 2px solid #8c2f1b Cinnabar border paired with a hard 3px 3px 0 architectural offset shadow.

dos: Do preserve the warm archival limestone palette (#f4f1ea / #fbf9f4 / #191714) and high-contrast mineral accents (#8c2f1b, #0e6b48, #1b4d8c) across all views.
Do deduplicate immutable ResourceVersion entries in node file lists while displaying their combined stage roles (e.g., G2 output · C3 input) and ownership scope (独有 vs. 共享).
Do keep URL query parameters (?view=...&node=...&stage=...&attempt=...&edge=...) synchronized with every selection change so any inspection state can be shared via link.
Do show explicit upstream attempt dependencies (G1 -> C1/C2 fail -> G2 -> C3 -> V2 pass) both in the 8-stage matrix and in the selected attempt detail box.
donts: Don't introduce chat boxes, prompt input bars, 'Run Optimization' action buttons, or fake WebSocket streaming animations in the read-only inspection prototype.
Don't conflate node/stage execution status (completed/running/failed/stopped) with resource cooling state (hot/ready-for-cool/cooled).
Don't allow unverified or in-progress nodes (N5) to appear as the best valid kernel in the header or summary rankings.
Don't render raw binary .db or .bin dumps in the file previewer; always render structured summary cards with SHA256 provenance and msprof pipeline utilization bars.
